forms:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>It’s about the <$cdef(27)>first floor of this building and its...entrance?
Whaddya call it, a foyer?
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,3)>Anyway, I was wonderin’ if we could jazz it up in here a
little. Right now it’s kinda meh.

<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>What about that machine? Y’know, the <$cdef(27)>PC at the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon
Center. You can <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>get all kinds of items from it, right?

<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>Think you could nab <$cdef(27)>two <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1654)> and plonk ’em
down on the <$cdef(27)>first floor of this building?
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>I got a feelin’ that’ll make this space look real nice!

<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,8)>You can get all kinds of items from the <$cdef(27)>PC at the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon
<$cdef(27)>Center, right, <$cdef(27)>?

<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,7)>Think you could nab <$cdef(27)>two <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1654)> and plonk ’em
down on the <$cdef(27)>first floor of the building?

<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Dang, those <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1654)> look great! Thanks a bunch,
<$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Now that’s how you make an entrance...for a building! Ha!
Or at least I think so!
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>May I ask you for a favor, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>?

<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Doesn’t the <$cdef(27)>second floor of this building seem like it
could be a fun place?
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,668)><$voicel(4,9)>I was thinking it might be a good spot to put out some
playthings for other Pokémon to enjoy.

<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,661)><$voicel(4,5)>You can obtain all kinds of items from the <$cdef(27)>PC at the
<$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center, isn’t that right?

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>If you come across a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2055)>, I would appreciate it if you
could place it on the <$cdef(27)>second floor.

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>I would appreciate it if you could place a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2055)> on
the <$cdef(27)>second floor of the building.

<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,8)>Do you think you could get one from the <$cdef(27)>PC at the
<$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center?

<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,668)><$voicel(4,10)>I noticed you put a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2055)> on the <$cdef(27)>second floor!
<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Thank you for doing that, <$cdef(27)>. I’m
sure
everyone
will
have
such
fun
playing
on it! ♪
